---
title: "Verify flat supplementary workbook"
format: html
---

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,math
from openpyxl import load_workbook
root=Path('/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569/derived')
out=root/'supplementary_workbook_2026-09-22-v1'
src=out/'Supplementary_Tables.xlsx'
index=json.loads((out/'INDEX.json').read_text())
w=load_workbook(src,read_only=True,data_only=False)
assert w.sheetnames==['Index']+[r['Sheet'] for r in index]+['Column definitions']
checks=[]
for i,entry in enumerate(index,1):
 d=json.loads((out/f'S{i}.json').read_text());sheet=w[d['sheet']]
 actual=sheet.iter_rows(values_only=True)
 assert list(next(actual))==d['headers']
 count=0
 for expected,found in zip(d['rows'],actual,strict=True):
  assert len(expected)==len(found)
  for x,y in zip(expected,found):
   if isinstance(x,(int,float)) and not isinstance(x,bool):
    assert isinstance(y,(int,float)) and math.isclose(x,y,rel_tol=1e-14,abs_tol=0),(entry['Sheet'],count,x,y)
   else:assert x==y,(entry['Sheet'],count,x,y)
  count+=1
 assert count==entry['Rows']
 checks.append({'sheet':entry['Sheet'],'rows':count,'all_cells_match':True})
 print(entry['Sheet'],count,flush=True)
for p in json.loads((out/'PROVENANCE.json').read_text()):
 assert hashlib.sha256((root/p['source']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==p['sha256']
(out/'CHECKS.json').write_text(json.dumps({'source_hashes_verified':True,'tables':checks,'bytes':src.stat().st_size,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(src.read_bytes()).hexdigest()},indent=2))
print('VERIFIED')
```
